mn78:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn78:1.3: tena kho pana samayena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto samayappavādake tiṇḍukācīre ekasālake mallikāya ārāme paṭivasati mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ pañcamattehi paribbājakasatehi.
mn78:2.1: atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati sāvatthiyā nikkhami divādivassa bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
mn78:2.7: yannūnāhaṃ yena samayappavādako tiṇḍukācīro ekasālako mallikāya ārāmo yena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto tenupasaṅkameyyanti.
mn78:2.8: atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati yena samayappavādako tiṇḍukācīro ekasālako mallikāya ārāmo tenupasaṅkami.
mn78:3.1: tena kho pana samayena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto mahatiyā paribbājakaparisāya saddhiṃ nisinno hoti unnādiniyā uccāsaddamahāsaddāya anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentiyā seyyathīdaṃ
mn78:3.2: rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mahāmattakathaṃ senākathaṃ bhayakathaṃ yuddhakathaṃ annakathaṃ pānakathaṃ vatthakathaṃ sayanakathaṃ mālākathaṃ gandhakathaṃ ñātikathaṃ yānakathaṃ gāmakathaṃ nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthīkathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ kumbhadāsikathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lokakkhāyikaṃ samuddakkhāyikaṃ itibhavābhavakathaṃ iti vā.
mn78:3.3: addasā kho uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ dūrato āgacchantaṃ
mn78:3.5: appasaddā bhonto hontu mā bhonto saddamakattha
mn78:3.6: samaṇassa gotamassa sāvako āgacchati pañcakaṅgo thapati
mn78:3.7: yāvatā kho pana samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataro pañcakaṅgo thapati
mn78:3.8: appasaddakāmā kho pana te āyasmanto appasaddavinītā appasaddassa vaṇṇavādino
mn78:3.9: appevanāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃ viditvā upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyyāti.
mn78:3.10: atha kho te paribbājakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ.
mn78:4.1: atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati yena uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā uggāhamānena paribbājakena samaṇamuṇḍikāputtena saddhiṃ sammodi
mn78:4.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ uggāhamāno paribbājako samaṇamuṇḍikāputto etadavoca
mn78:5.1: catūhi kho ahaṃ thapati dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamappattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ
mn78:5.3: idha thapati na kāyena pāpakaṃ kammaṃ karoti na pāpikaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati na pāpakaṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti na pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvati
mn78:5.4: imehi kho ahaṃ thapati catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ parisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi sampannakusalaṃ paramakusalaṃ uttamappattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhanti.
mn78:6.1: atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati uggāhamānassa paribbājakassa samaṇamuṇḍikāputtassa bhāsitaṃ neva abhinandi nappaṭikkosi
mn78:6.3: bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmīti.
mn78:7.1: atha kho pañcakaṅgo thapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn78:7.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho pañcakaṅgo thapati yāvatako ahosi uggāhamānena paribbājakena samaṇamuṇḍikāputtena saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
mn78:8.1: evaṃ vutte bhagavā pañcakaṅgaṃ thapatiṃ etadavoca
mn78:8.2: evaṃ sante kho thapati daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako sampannakusalo bhavissati paramakusalo uttamappattipatto samaṇo ayojjho yathā uggāhamānassa paribbājakassa samaṇamuṇḍikāputtassa vacanaṃ.
mn78:8.3: daharassa hi thapati kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa kāyotipi na hoti kuto pana kāyena pāpakaṃ kammaṃ karissati aññatra phanditamattā.
mn78:8.4: daharassa hi thapati kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa vācātipi na hoti kuto pana pāpikaṃ vācaṃ bhāsissati aññatra roditamattā.
mn78:8.5: daharassa hi thapati kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa saṅkappotipi na hoti kuto pana pāpakaṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappissati aññatra vikujjitamattā.
mn78:8.6: daharassa hi thapati kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa ājīvotipi na hoti kuto pana pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvissati aññatra mātu thaññā.
mn78:8.7: evaṃ sante kho thapati daharo kumāro mando uttānaseyyako sampannakusalo bhavissati paramakusalo uttamappattipatto samaṇo ayojjho yathā uggāhamānassa paribbājakassa samaṇamuṇḍikāputtassa vacanaṃ.
mn78:8.8: catūhi kho ahaṃ thapati dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi na ceva sampannakusalaṃ na paramakusalaṃ na uttamappattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ apicimaṃ daharaṃ kumāraṃ mandaṃ uttānaseyyakaṃ samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati
mn78:8.10: idha thapati kāyena pāpakaṃ kammaṃ karoti na pāpikaṃ vācaṃ bhāsati na pāpakaṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti na pāpakaṃ ājīvaṃ ājīvati
mn78:8.11: imehi kho ahaṃ thapati catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ purisapuggalaṃ paññāpemi na ceva sampannakusalaṃ na paramakusalaṃ na uttamappattipattaṃ samaṇaṃ ayojjhaṃ apicimaṃ daharaṃ kumāraṃ mandaṃ uttānaseyyakaṃ samadhiggayha tiṭṭhati.
